name: discord-patch-bot
description: Bot Discord pentru update-uri automate la jocuri

scripts.build:rust: cd native && napi build --platform --release --js index.js --dts index.d.ts
scripts.build:inspector: npm run build:ts && npm run build:inspector:prebuilt
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start:local
scripts.check:config: npm run build:ts && npm run check:config:prebuilt
scripts.check:env: npm run build:ts && npm run check:env:prebuilt
scripts.check:redis: npm run build:ts && npm run check:redis:prebuilt
scripts.check:dependencies: npm run build:ts && npm run check:dependencies:prebuilt
scripts.check:layers: npm run build:ts && npm run check:layers:prebuilt
scripts.check:syntax: npm run build:ts && npm run check:syntax:prebuilt
scripts.check:comments: npm run build:ts && npm run check:comments:prebuilt
scripts.check:weakening: npm run build:ts && npm run check:weakening:prebuilt
scripts.check:rules-sync: npm run build:ts && npm run check:rules-sync:prebuilt
scripts.check:db-indexes: npm run build:ts && npm run check:db-indexes:prebuilt
scripts.check:docs-commands: npm run build:ts && npm run check:docs-commands:prebuilt
scripts.check:quick: npm run build:ts && npm run check:quick:prebuilt
scripts.docs:commands: npm run build:ts && npm run docs:commands:prebuilt
scripts.db:export:guilds: npm run build:ts && npm run db:export:guilds:prebuilt
scripts.benchmark: npm run build:ts && npm run benchmark:prebuilt
scripts.benchmark:outbox: npm run build:ts && npm run benchmark:outbox:prebuilt
scripts.benchmark:cpu: npm run build && npm run benchmark:cpu:prebuilt
scripts.benchmark:inspection: npm run build && npm run benchmark:inspection:prebuilt
scripts.benchmark:guard: npm run build && npm run benchmark:guard:prebuilt
scripts.smoke:staging: npm run build:ts && npm run smoke:staging:prebuilt
scripts.smoke:staging:discord: npm run build:ts && npm run smoke:staging:discord:prebuilt
scripts.canary:sources: npm run build:ts && npm run canary:sources:prebuilt
scripts.lint: npm run build:ts && npm run lint:prebuilt
scripts.lint:prebuilt: node dist/scripts/check-syntax.js && node dist/scripts/check-no-comments.js && node dist/scripts/check-no-nul-bytes.js && node dist/scripts/check-no-weakening-types.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:prebuilt
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:prebuilt
scripts.test:regression: npm run build && npm run test:regression:prebuilt
scripts.test:notifications: npm run build && npm run test:notifications:prebuilt
scripts.precommit: npm run check:full && npm run audit
scripts.check: node scripts/run-parallel.ts build:ts build:rust && npm run check:prebuilt
scripts.check:ts-prebuilt: npm run build:ts && npm run check:prebuilt
scripts.profile:tests: npm run build:ts && npm run profile:tests:prebuilt
scripts.sbom:native: npm run build:ts && npm run sbom:native:prebuilt
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run check:native && npm run test:e2e:prebuilt
scripts.check:env:local: npm run build:ts && npm run check:env:local:prebuilt
scripts.check:redis:local: npm run build:ts && npm run check:redis:local:prebuilt
scripts.doctor:local: npm run build:ts && npm run doctor:local:prebuilt
scripts.doctor:local:prebuilt: node --env-file=.env dist/scripts/check-env.js && node --env-file=.env dist/scripts/check-config.js && node --env-file=.env dist/scripts/check-mongo.js && node --env-file=.env dist/scripts/check-redis.js
scripts.db:export:guilds:raw: npm run build:ts && npm run db:export:guilds:raw:prebuilt
scripts.check:mongo:local: npm run build:ts && npm run check:mongo:local:prebuilt
